g.text: Induction-motor torque rises to breakdown, then falls toward synchronous speed

g.text: Illustrative fixed-voltage/frequency model T/T_max=2(s/s_b)/[1+(s/s_b)²], s_b=0.20, f=60 Hz, p=4. It captures motoring shape rather than a specific motor
rating. Starting torque is at s=1; torque is zero at synchronous speed in this ideal model. Generator/braking regions are not plotted.
